text: Same-Day Dental Implants in McLean & Alexandria, VA

With All-on-4, most patients leave the surgery wearing a fixed provisional arch: four implants and a full set of teeth in a single visit. The final zirconia arch follows three to four months later. Planned and placed by board-certified prosthodontist Dr. Esam Nahlah.
Same-day teeth are real teeth, for now.

On implant day you receive a fully functional provisional arch in PMMA, fitted the day the implants go in and screwed down, not a removable denture. It carries you through the months while the implants fuse, and then it is replaced by the final arch in zirconia.
What happens on implant day, and in the months after.
An examination and a cone-beam scan show whether there is enough bone to load straight away. You leave knowing whether you qualify, what it costs and how long it takes.

Four implants placed through a printed guide, under local anesthetic with nitrous oxide or oral sedation, and the provisional arch fitted before you go home. After oral sedation, someone needs to drive you.
Three to four months while bone grows onto the implants: soft foods for those months, and reviews along the way to check integration and adjust the provisional.
The zirconia arch replaces the provisional, and two to four more months finish the healing around it. From then on it is brushed and flossed like natural teeth.
Who can have teeth the same day.
Same-day teeth need implants steady enough to carry a provisional arch on the day they go in. The cone-beam scan decides that at the consultation, and in most All-on-4 cases the answer is yes.

faq: Can I really get teeth the same day as my implants?
With All-on-4, in most cases yes. You leave the same visit wearing a fixed provisional arch, and the final zirconia arch is fitted three to four months later.
Are same-day teeth my final teeth?
No. The same-day arch is a provisional in PMMA, fully functional and screwed in place, and it is adjusted at reviews while the implants fuse. The final arch is zirconia.
What can I eat with same-day teeth?
Soft foods for the next several months, while the implants integrate with the jawbone. That part is not optional, and it is the one people underestimate.
It is done under local anesthetic with nitrous oxide or oral sedation, so you stay relaxed throughout. Afterwards, patients generally report minor discomfort that over-the-counter medication handles.
What if I have bone loss?

Bone loss often makes you a candidate for All-on-4 rather than ruling you out, because the rear implants are angled toward denser bone. Some cases still need grafting first, and then the teeth wait for the bone to heal.
Can a single tooth be replaced the same day?
Sometimes. Where the case allows, the implant goes in at the time of the extraction, and qualifying patients leave with a temporary the same day. The scan shows whether yours qualifies.
